lead.en: Share a link, change access and send to recent recipients.
lead.zh: 复制链接、设置访问权限并发送给最近联系人。

rule.en: Open Share, select access and recipients, then send. Escape closes the access list before the panel.
rule.zh: 打开分享，选择权限和收件人后发送。Esc 优先关闭权限列表。

api.en: Set people, access, channels, trigger label and alignment. Delivery callbacks resolve asynchronously. Copy reports the selected access only after a confirmed write.
api.zh: 配置联系人、访问级别、渠道、按钮文案和对齐。发送等待宿主结果，复制写入成功后回调所选权限。

motion.en: The shared surface springs between trigger, panel and confirmation. Picked avatars travel to the recipient row. At 520px and below the panel opens from the bottom.
motion.zh: 同一外框在触发键、面板和确认卡之间缓动，选中的头像移入收件人行。520px 及以下从底部展开。

lead.en: Expand a responsive navigation bar into grouped destinations or local search.
lead.zh: 在同一个导航栏内展开栏目、搜索或紧凑菜单。

rule.en: Hover a section to expand it. On narrow screens, open Menu to browse groups. Open Search to filter the local index. Escape restores focus.
rule.zh: 悬停展开栏目。窄屏可打开菜单查看分组，也可使用搜索筛选。Esc 关闭并恢复焦点。

api.en: Provide stable destination IDs and route the emitted event. Container width below 720px defaults to a grouped menu. Search takes an optional independent index.
api.zh: 使用稳定的目标 ID，并由宿主处理导航事件。容器宽度低于 720px 时默认显示分组菜单。搜索可接入独立索引。

motion.en: Hover opens after 60ms and closes after 180ms on exit. Panel size and highlight retarget from their current position.
motion.zh: 悬停 60ms 展开，移出 180ms 后收起。面板尺寸和高亮从当前位置继续过渡。

lead.en: Switch editor tools in a floating dock with group trays and optional reordering.
lead.zh: 在浮动工具栏切换编辑工具、展开分组托盘和调整顺序。

rule.en: Pick a tool, open Shapes or move a slot. The example board owns the shortcut keys and editing actions.
rule.zh: 选择工具、打开形状托盘或拖动排序。快捷键和编辑操作由画板宿主处理。

api.en: Supply stable tool IDs and an optional selected value. Apply reorder events by passing the accepted order back to set_items.
api.zh: 提供稳定的工具 ID 和可选的选中值。收到重排事件后，用 set_items 传回接受的顺序。

motion.en: Selection and labels glide between fixed 40px slots. Trays rise above the bar and show their tools in sequence.
motion.zh: 选中底片和标签在 40px 槽位间滑动。托盘从工具栏上方展开，依次显示工具。

lead.en: Switch app sections with a draggable lens, measured labels, and rolling badges.
lead.zh: 用可拖动的镜片切换栏目，经过图标时局部反色，并显示滚动徽标。

rule.en: Tap a section, drag the selected lens, or use Arrow Left and Right, Home, and End.
rule.zh: 点按栏目、拖动选中镜片，或用左右方向键、Home 和 End 切换。

api.en: Supply stable values and accept the selection in the host. Choose Active, Always, or None for captions. Each item can supply an alternate icon and an accessible badge label.
api.zh: 为每项提供稳定值，由宿主接收选择。标签可显示当前项、全部或仅图标，支持独立选中图标和徽标播报。

motion.en: A 420ms morph spring retargets the lens. The previous caption fades as the new caption waits for the lens. Reduced motion settles the layout immediately.
motion.zh: 镜片使用 420ms 弹簧。原标签先淡出，新标签等镜片到达再显现。减少动态效果时直接切换。

lead.en: Open a radial menu and pick a photo action with one press and drag.
lead.zh: 点按展开环形菜单，或按住并拖向照片操作。

rule.en: Tap to keep the arc open. Press and drag to an action, then release. Escape cancels.
rule.zh: 短按可保留菜单。按住拖向动作后松手即可触发，按 Esc 或拖出弧区可取消。

api.en: Supply actions with stable IDs, optional confirmations and a danger tone. The host handles each invocation.
api.zh: 为每个动作提供稳定 ID、可选回执和危险样式，由宿主处理动作。

motion.en: The actions swirl out and collapse in reverse. A single highlight follows the pointer and the confirmation lasts 1.4 seconds.
motion.zh: 动作沿弧线依次展开，按反序收起。高亮随目标移动，回执显示 1.4 秒。
